title: ContiLNN: Mitigating Slice Sampling Discontinuity with Liquid Neural Networks for Medical Image Restoration
abstract: arXiv:2610.12337v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Anatomical continuity provides complementary information for medical image restoration, but its use requires accounting for local anatomy and variations in slice sampling. We introduce ContiLNN, which augments two-dimensional restoration backbones with bidirectional closed-form continuous-time (Bi-CfC) modules for cross-slice modeling while retaining in-plane feature extraction. Slice-index intervals modulate gates determined by local features and hidden states, enabling propagation to respond to sampling variations without numerical ODE integration. translated_title: ContiLNN：利用液体神经网络缓解切片采样不连续性以实现医学图像恢复
translated_abstract: 解剖连续性为医学图像恢复提供了互补信息，但其利用需要考虑局部解剖结构和切片采样的变化。我们提出了ContiLNN，它通过双向闭式连续时间模块增强二维恢复骨干网络以进行跨切片建模，同时保留平面内特征提取。切片索引间隔对由局部特征和隐藏状态确定的门控进行调制，使信息传播能够响应采样变化而无需数值ODE积分。参考引导的一致性对齐一阶和二阶跨切片强度差异以保留解剖变化，同时从冻结骨干网络的蒸馏有助于保持平面内保真度。在五个训练随机种子上，ContiLNN在CT去噪、MRI超分辨率和低计数PET恢复任务中分别比Restore-RWKV平均PSNR提高0.1907、1.0176和1.2482 dB。
tldr: 提出ContiLNN，利用双向闭式连续时间液体神经网络模块进行跨切片建模，结合参考引导的一致性约束和冻结骨干蒸馏，有效缓解医学图像恢复中的切片采样不连续问题，在CT去噪、MRI超分辨率和低计数PET恢复任务上均显著优于Restore-RWKV。
en_tdlr: ContiLNN introduces bidirectional closed-form continuous-time (Bi-CfC) liquid neural network modules for cross-slice modeling, combined with reference-guided consistency and frozen-backbone distillation, to mitigate slice sampling discontinuity in medical image restoration, outperforming Restore-RWKV in CT denoising, MRI super-resolution, and reduced-count PET restoration.
